description: Marks a specific Chat conversation as read on behalf of the authenticated user. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Without action_signatures the conversation is marked read up to its newest event and the read receipt is unsigned. With one action signature over a MarkConversationReadEvent, the server sends that signed read receipt, marking the conversation read up to the event it names.

action_signatures.description: Signature over the read receipt (a MarkConversationReadEvent). Omit to send it unsigned.

encoded_message_event_detail.description: Base64-encoded Thrift MessageEventDetail for the signed action.

message_signing_key_info_list.description: List of signing key information for message verification.

public_key_version.description: The version of the public key used for signing.

signature.description: The signature of the message event.

signature_version.description: The version of the signature algorithm.

signing_public_key.description: The public key used for signing.

message_id.description: Client-generated ID of the message being signed.

signature_payload.description: Payload string the client signed; used only in server-side failure logs.
